biography.plain_text: Eugene Lynn was an American insurance magnate based in Boca Raton. A former pilot, he bought his uncle James J. Lynn’s insurance companies and led the Lynn Insurance Group. His family connections included a substantial interest under his uncle’s will, alongside his own long career as an insurance owner and executive.

long_biography.plain_text:
Insurance businessman Eugene Lynn helped finance the expansion of two Florida universities. His gift enabled Stetson University to purchase a rundown, six-storey bank building in 1990 for its growing business school. An eighteen-month conversion created classrooms, faculty offices and meeting rooms around a new central atrium.

In Boca Raton, Lynn developed a friendship with college president Donald Ross and became both a donor and a trustee. The College of Boca Raton adopted the name Lynn University in 1991, recognising the support of Eugene and his wife, Christine. Their gifts helped provide a communication building, library and student accommodation. He remained a trustee until his death.
